# RestroDash

> The offline-first restaurant operating system and POS engine for high-volume dining.

RestroDash provides local-authoritative SQLite table ordering, host-peer collaborative QR dining, multi-station kitchen display systems (KDS), and ESC/POS thermal printing with zero cloud latency and guaranteed LAN continuity.

## Core Capabilities

- **Offline-First SQLite WAL Engine:** Tableside billing, inventory deductions, and split checks commit locally in sub-millisecond transactions on Port 3001 without cloud WAN dependencies.
- **Host-Peer Collaborative QR Dining:** Diners scan table QR codes where the first scanner is designated as the Table Host (Master). Companions join via a secure 4-digit session PIN to propose items into a synchronized real-time cart. Only the Host holds checkout and bill settlement authority, preventing accidental or rogue orders.
- **Multi-Station Kitchen Display System (KDS):** Standalone KDS server runs on Port 3002. Orders route automatically by kitchen prep station (Grill, Saute, Bar, Bakery) with touch bump stages and zero external latency.
- **ESC/POS Thermal Printing:** Native ESC/POS driver supporting 58mm and 80mm printers over USB, Ethernet/LAN, and Serial, tested against golden column alignment oracles for receipts and kitchen KOTs.
- **Dedicated VPS Cloud Isolation:** Each restaurant brand receives an isolated VPS instance and custom subdomain (`subdomain.restrodash.in`) with automated encrypted daily cloud backups and zero per-order commissions.

## Commercial Pricing

- **Monthly Subscription:** ₹35,000 / month flat rate.
- **Annual Subscription:** ₹29,166 / month (billed annually, 17% savings).
- **Per-Order Commission:** 0%.
- **Terminals & Devices:** Unlimited POS counters, unlimited KDS displays, unlimited QR table scans.
